name: ugcbuilder
description: Create landing-page section images and UGC videos with UGCBuilder, and retrieve temporary generation downloads.

interface.longDescription: Create landing-page section images and UGC videos from a product photo and your creative brief. Choose a format and approve each generation in the interactive card, then download your result. Connect your UGCBuilder account to get started.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create landing-page images for my product using UGCBuilder.

positive.description: Read-only account check. Setup: reviewer is OAuth connected to a funded UGCBuilder test account. Pass: report the returned balance and current section/video prices without estimating them.
positive.prompt: How many UGCBuilder credits do I have, and what does one Landing Page Pro section and one premium video step cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_account once and reports creditsAvailable and the returned prices. Does not start generation or spend credits.

positive.description: Single section approval flow. Setup: test account has at least 15 credits and the public product image is reachable. Pass: the card shows one section and the exact cost; no generation starts until reviewer approval.
positive.prompt: Prepare one English landing page hero image for https://ugcbuilder.com/premium-ugc/products/collagen-coffee.jpg. Use the exact headline "Make your morning yours" and CTA "Shop now". Keep the product visible and show free shipping.
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_landing_page; get_landing_page_request for status if needed
positive.expected_behavior: Passes the full brief and exact copy, one hero section with a product-specific defaultPrompt, and a stable idempotency key. The card offers format selection and 15-credit approval. After approval, reports a completed download link and expiry time supported by the returned status.

positive.description: Multi-section approval flow. Setup: test account has at least 30 credits and the public product image is reachable. Pass: both sections retain their copy and run sequentially only after one total-cost approval.
positive.prompt: Prepare two English landing page images for https://ugcbuilder.com/premium-ugc/products/collagen-coffee.jpg: a hero with exact headline "Your morning, your way" and CTA "Try it", followed by an FAQ with exact question "How long does shipping take?" and answer "3–5 business days".
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_landing_page; get_landing_page_request for status if needed
positive.expected_behavior: Prepares hero then FAQ in one request with the exact text and section order. The card shows a 30-credit total and does not charge before approval. After approval, shares each completed section download and expiry.

positive.description: Premium video with one extension. Setup: funded test account has at least 400 credits and the public product image is reachable. Pass: card displays the full script, portrait/landscape choice and total before any generation.
positive.prompt: Make a 15-second premium UGC video using https://ugcbuilder.com/premium-ugc/products/collagen-coffee.jpg. Dialogue: "This is my morning coffee routine. I make a cup, take a sip, and head out." Use a natural kitchen scene and English speech.
positive.tools_triggered: generate_ugc_video; get_landing_page_request for status if needed
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_ugc_video once with the full script, desiredDurationSeconds 15, product image URL and stable key. The card shows an estimated roughly 15-second video and 400-credit approval. After reviewer approval, shares the completed video download and expiry; it does not start a duplicate request.

positive.description: Retrieve an existing temporary result. Setup: run after a completed image case while its job remains in memory; use that job ID. Pass: return the existing link without starting new generation.
positive.prompt: Show me the download link for the landing page image we just generated and tell me when it expires.
positive.tools_triggered: get_generation or display_generation; list_generations only if the job ID is unavailable
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the existing job owned by the test account, shares the returned downloadMarkdown or URL and expiresAt, and does not call a paid generation tool.

negative.description: Website publishing is outside this MCP's scope. Pass: explain that Landing Page Pro returns section images and cannot publish HTML/CSS; do not call a generation tool.
negative.prompt: Build and publish a working HTML landing page with a custom domain using UGCBuilder.

negative.description: Credit purchases and refunds are outside the MCP tool surface. Pass: direct the user to UGCBuilder's account or support path without claiming a transaction or invoking generation.
negative.prompt: Buy me 500 UGCBuilder credits and charge my card here in chat.

negative.description: The MCP has no durable media history. Pass: explain the temporary in-memory limit and avoid inventing or regenerating old outputs.
negative.prompt: Recover every UGCBuilder image I made three months ago, including expired download links.

publication.release_notes: Initial public package for UGCBuilder's OAuth MCP: Landing Page Pro approval cards, premium UGC video approval, account checks, and temporary result downloads.
